summary: Master strategic execution and operating rhythm with OKRs, KPI dashboards, and practical governance routines. Learn to turn strategy into action.
lede: Strategy execution turns priorities into accountable work through clear ownership, regular performance reviews, and escalation routines. For professionals working in strategy, performance, or cross-functional delivery, the course covers OKR alignment, KPI dashboard and review design, and dependency management, with practice creating operating rhythms and executive reporting packs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with strategy, performance, or cross-functional delivery and need a more reliable execution system. It is especially relevant if you are responsible for cadence, accountability, KPI reporting, or leadership follow-up across multiple teams. Strategy Managers who track strategic priorities and governance cadence. PMO Managers who monitor initiative delivery and escalation routes. Operations Managers who run KPI reviews and corrective actions. Program Managers who coordinate cross-functional dependencies and action logs. Functional Heads who align teams to scorecards and operating rhythms. Performance Management Specialists who maintain dashboards and review packs. Business Analysts who map KPI trees and reporting flows. Chief of Staff professionals who coordinate executive follow-up and decision logs. Continuous Improvement Leads who use PDCA for execution control. Transformation Managers who manage strategy rollout and accountability routines.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop and a working knowledge of strategy documents, KPI reports, or project status updates from your role. You do not need programming skills, and any digital exercises can be completed with Excel or Power BI depending on the tools available in your workplace.
